meta_title: Fonder — a film camera for iPhone
meta_description: Fonder turns your iPhone into a film camera: {{film_count}} films, recipes you set like a camera, and Film Roll — shoot a roll, then develop it.
lang_bar_text: Xem trang này bằng tiếng Việt?
ch1_body: {{film_count}} films, each with its own colour. Recipes you set like a camera: white balance, dynamic range, grain, colour. Still, Cine and Roll.
ch2_body: Films fitted to real camera renders, not filters painted by eye. Halation, grain and the whole look are rendered on the iPhone, in the viewfinder and in the photo.
app_note_developing: Each frame gets the look you loaded. No settings to choose.
app_note_developed: Final photos. The Afterglow Neg look is set, so there’s nothing to edit or regrade.
ch3_body: Load a roll, shoot it blind, then develop it all at once — with a border and a date stamp if you like.
ch3_contact_caption: A developed roll, straight from Film Roll.
action_follow_body: Follow Fonder to get the link first.
footer_line: Made in Hà Nội by Trung Hai.
